## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `87c5223b80d91f249ef0a202dfedd6cee3124145`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/agents/os-dev.md (lines 287–290, the roster the cut cites), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS rows: SKILL.md 319, triage-duties.md 99, os-dev.md 405), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (pattern), scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs (frame anchors), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (MAINTAINER_BRIEF_MARKER), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md line 20 (cut-survival rule), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md lines 102 and 129, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set or public-surface change: the net diff against `main` is +2/−1 lines in two files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`, a surface no package exports, no schema reads and no consumer loads. Judged right; nothing a consumer can author or import moves.
- Process-surface change 1, SKILL.md line 215 (new): 「新键/值/导出名有先例(spec、生产者或标准同词同概念):席位点名先例,否决窗口落地。」 narrows what reaches the maintainer by one explicit carve-out. It sits inside 〈升级与决策〉 after the discretion sentence (214, 维护者否决窗口而非许可门) and before the human-floor line (216, 任一命中即呈维护者 ⛔ 不入 PM 裁量), so a floor hit still overrides it and the section's opening test (211, 真实分歧且既有规范定不了) stays the only escalation path for a name. Judged right: it is the maintainer's 「只有真分歧才送」 in rule form.
- Process-surface change 2, triage-duties.md line 40 (new): 「先例已定新键/导出名非契约形状提案;分诊审计 ⛔ 不自加门,唯语义/形状真分歧呈人。」 negates, for the precedent-settled case, the 契约形状提案 arm of the `needs-user-decision` definition on line 39 and forbids the audit comment's own approval gate. Judged right: it removes exactly the reading that stalled six accepted PRs, while the `Feature` type criterion (line 55) and the 条款② test (line 94) are untouched, so a new key still declares `Clause-②: yes` / `Metadata-protocol: added` where it widens the accept set — only the approval step moves.
- Untouched, as the card orders: AGENTS.md, the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class of scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs (not referenced by either new line), and the six already-ruled cards. Verified on the file list: two paths only.
- The cut, SKILL.md old line 192 「速读六行固定:改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的。」: a seat-protocol line removed to pay the ratchet; its content stands verbatim at .claude/agents/os-dev.md line 288. Judged under ④.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` label on the PR, `Check Changeset` check-run success. Matches the diff: `.claude/**` publishes nothing from any released package; no `packages/**`, no `exports`, no schema.
- `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim (comment 6594661105): right — no accept set widened, nothing narrowed, no `(narrowing)` arm, so no dogfood battery owed. `Metadata-protocol: none`: right, no metadata author can write anything new.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev's `os-dev-report` (comment 6596975019): `open_questions` empty; four declared deviations, each answered:

1. Sentence landed in BOTH files — the card's Reader line reads 「`SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉 and/or `references/triage-duties.md`」, so both placements are inside the order; the two lines agree and do not restate each other (one is the seat's call, the other is triage's non-gate). Accepted. The triage copy's narrower noun list is a should-fix under ④, not a flag.
2. Ratchet paid by cutting the six-line roster, home named as os-dev.md — judged under ④: the roster survives verbatim; a pointer is owed as should-fix.
3. No subscription, assignee or reviewer request at `pr_create` — os-dev.md line 38 (PR ⛔ 不带 `assignees`,人经席位交棒才见 PR) and line 62 (`pr_create` draft, 含 labels, ⛔ 无 assignees) order exactly that; Tier S has no human reviewer to request. Conforms; the seat sets what its handover needs.
4. Worktree kept for a patch round — ordinary. Accepted.

Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, head repo equals base repo — a relay write, not a fork, no off-relay note owed. PR is draft, auto-merge null, zero reviews, zero PR comments at review time.

Check-runs on the head, all 43 completed: every gate-carrying job success — `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, the three `Lint · scoped` jobs, `Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Auto Label`, `filter`, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. The remaining entries read `skipped` and are the expected skips for a diff with no package path (UI build, e2e, docs build, temporal conformance, opt-in harnesses, the schedule gate, and the duplicate-run copies of Check Changeset / Check PR Size / Auto Label). No red, nothing in progress at the time of this record.

### ④ Design judgment

**SKILL.md** (hits):

- Acceptance, precedent test: 「有先例(spec、生产者或标准同词同概念)」 names same word, same concept, in spec / producer / standard. Holds, in those words.
- Acceptance, seat lands under the veto window: 「席位点名先例,否决窗口落地」; the line above (214) already fixes 否决窗口 as the opposite of 许可门, so "no approval line" is carried by the pairing. Holds. The card's "in the PR body" is not spelled — the line says who names the precedent, not where; the PR body is the only artefact of the seat's the maintainer reads at the veto window, so this is not a finding.
- Acceptance, genuine divergence is the only path to the maintainer: not on line 215 itself but on the unchanged opener 211 (真实分歧且既有规范定不了) and on triage-duties 40 (唯语义/形状真分歧呈人). Holds as a pair.
- Ratchet paid line for line: 319 → 319 against CEILINGS row 319 (check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs line 413); one real deletion, no re-wrap anywhere in the hunk. Touched line 114 bytes. No issue number (id-lint pattern is a hash followed by three or more digits; none in either new line). `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success on the head confirms the derived families.
- Frame-sync: the edit is outside the four-axis frame block the gate anchors (the block begins after line 241); the gate compares the frame's structure only. Green on the head. Holds.
- The cut, judged against the skills lane's own rule (lanes/skills.md line 20: 「砍点逐条核幸存,被砍内容若在别处无家,砍掉就是丢规则」): the roster survives verbatim at os-dev.md line 288 「六行固定:改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的。」 together with its fuller companions on lines 289–290 (先看 ≤3 文件按风险排; 两分钟验证 = 一条命令或一次点击; 需要你做的恰一个动作, 非受管面写「无,席位落地」) — a stronger statement than the one cut. The seat already reads os-dev.md as protocol: SKILL.md line 280 houses the dev's report JSON shape there with 「⛔ 不抄第二份」, execution-duties.md line 102 lists os-dev.md in the 协议语义面, and line 129 assumes the seat knows what os-dev.md already carries when trimming a dispatch prompt. So the roster has a home on the seat's reading path and no rule is dropped. What the cut does drop is the POINTER: after it, the seat-record block says 六行 three times (lines 188, 192, 193) and names one heading on its own (line 200, 「需要你做的」) without saying where the six are listed, and check-half-states.mjs enforces only the `## 维护者速读` heading (MAINTAINER_BRIEF_MARKER), never the six names — so a dev draft with five lines or a renamed heading is caught only by the seat's eye at 终稿, and that eye now has no roster in its own file. **should-fix**: fold a pointer into line 192 (107 bytes today), e.g. 「- 草稿归 dev:PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读` 六行(见 os-dev.md),中文、业务角度,不写席位意见。」 — measured 115 bytes, net 0 lines, no re-wrap. Not a must-fix: the roster exists, verbatim, in the file whose reader writes the draft, and the line-280 precedent shows the seat is already sent there for a sibling shape.
- Attempts to break line 215: (i) read as overriding the human floor — no, line 216 follows it and says 任一命中即呈维护者 ⛔ 不入 PM 裁量, so a name on a card that also hits a floor still goes up; (ii) read as covering a name with no precedent — no, 有先例 is the antecedent, and without it line 211 governs; (iii) read as touching the DELIBERATE CORRECTION gate or `Clause-②` — no, neither is named and the 条款② test (triage-duties 94) is unchanged, so a precedent-settled name that widens the accept set still owes its contract-tier review before the queue.

**triage-duties.md** (hits):

- Line 40 is the negation of line 39's 契约形状提案 arm for the precedent-settled case plus the no-self-gate clause for the audit comment; 116 bytes; 96 → 97 lines against the 99 ceiling (row at check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs line 1347); no issue number. Placed directly under the definition it qualifies, so a triage reader meets both in one glance. Holds.
- **should-fix**: the line reads 「新键/导出名」 while SKILL.md line 215 and the card's rule name a key, an accepted VALUE and an export name. From this line alone, triage could still read a new accepted value with precedent (an enum member spelled as the standard spells it) as a 契约形状提案. Adding 「/值」 measures 120 bytes, at the ceiling, net 0 lines.
- The card located the definition on line 42; it is line 39 on `main` — the dev measured and reported this in Acceptance notes. No finding.

Net: two should-fix, zero must-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-wvlstx`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f93dee0dc5764b56684886cde44ff9acfa42a580`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/agents/os-dev.md (lines 287–290, the roster the new pointer names), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS rows: SKILL.md 319, triage-duties.md 99), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (pattern)

Delta review of one commit, `f93dee0d`, on top of the head reviewed at `87c5223b` (record of record for that head: PASS with two should-fix). Judged here: the delta only — whether it closes both should-fixes, whether it introduces anything new, and whether ratchet, bytes and id-lint still hold. Everything the earlier record judged on ①–④ and found holding is unchanged by this commit and is not re-judged.

### ① Derived judgments

- The delta touches exactly two lines, both already in the earlier record's scope: SKILL.md line 192 (seat-record block) and triage-duties.md line 40 (the new triage clause). No new path, no new rule, no accept-set or public-surface change; `.claude/**` still publishes nothing. Judged right.
- SKILL.md 192: 「每个 PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读` 六行,」 becomes 「PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读` 六行(见 os-dev.md),」 — the pointer the earlier record asked for, in the wording it measured. The dropped 「每个」 changes nothing: the rule already binds every PR through 「草稿归 dev」 and os-dev.md line 287 (受管与否都带). Judged right.
- triage-duties.md 40: 「新键/导出名」 becomes 「新键/值/导出名」 — now the same noun list as SKILL.md line 215 and the card's rule (key, accepted value, export name). Judged right.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `skip-changeset` label still on the PR; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` still right — the delta adds no published byte. Net diff against `main` is +3/−2 in the same two files.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No new dev report or deviation accompanies the delta; the commit is the two remedies and nothing else. Nothing to answer or escalate.
- PR state at review: draft, auto-merge null, head repo equals base repo, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Check-runs on `f93dee0d`, 38 at the time of this record: completed success — `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `Auto Label`, `filter`, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, the three `Lint · scoped` jobs; completed skipped — the expected skips for a diff with no package path (UI lint/type/test/build/e2e, Build Core, Build Docs, temporal conformance, opt-in harnesses, schedule gate, and a duplicate-run `Check Changeset`, whose first-run copy had not yet registered on this head when read). Still `in_progress` with no conclusion: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates` — seven jobs, every one of which read `success` on `87c5223b` for a tree this delta changes by two in-place line rewrites. No red. The adopting seat reads these seven to `success` before the ready/queue step, as the landing rule (every check green or expected skip) already requires; this verdict judges the tree, and the tree's ratchet, byte and id-lint readings are taken above from the committed files themselves.

### ④ Design judgment

**SKILL.md** (hits):

- should-fix 1 closed: line 192 now reads 「- 草稿归 dev:PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读` 六行(见 os-dev.md),中文、业务角度,不写席位意见。」 The seat-record block's three 六行 mentions (188, 192, 193) and the lone 「需要你做的」 on line 200 now resolve through 192 to os-dev.md, where lines 288–290 carry the roster verbatim and its three companion rules. The seat correcting a draft at 终稿 has its reference list one hop away in a file SKILL.md line 280 already sends it to. Holds.
- Ratchet: 319 → 319 against the 319 ceiling; the delta is an in-place rewrite of one line, no line added, no re-wrap (numstat 2/2 on this file against `main` — the two rewritten lines plus the roster cut from the first commit). Line 192 measures 115 bytes; line 215 unchanged at 114. No issue number in any added line (pattern: hash plus three or more digits — none). Holds.
- Nothing new: the pointer names a file, not a rule, and os-dev.md is unchanged on this head (405-line ceiling untouched). No wording elsewhere in the block moved.

**triage-duties.md** (hits):

- should-fix 2 closed: line 40 now reads 「- 先例已定新键/值/导出名非契约形状提案;分诊审计 ⛔ 不自加门,唯语义/形状真分歧呈人。」 — a new accepted value with precedent is no longer readable, from this line alone, as a 契约形状提案; the clause and SKILL.md 215 now name the same three kinds. Holds.
- Bytes: 120, exactly at the 120-byte line budget the card sets, as the earlier record measured; not over. 97 lines against the 99 ceiling, unchanged by the delta. No issue number. Holds.
- Nothing new: an in-place rewrite of the one line; its neighbours 39 and 41 are untouched.

Net: both should-fixes closed, zero new findings, zero must-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-wvlstx`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：pm-dispatch 规则加两句。有仓内先例（spec、生产者或所实现的标准里同一个词、同一个概念）的新键名、取值或导出名，由席位自定，PR 里点名先例，在否决窗口内落地。分诊审计不再自加批准门，只有语义或契约形状上的真分歧才送你。另外，SKILL.md 里「速读六行」那一行改成指向 `os-dev.md`，用来付行数棘轮。
- 为什么改：你 11-03 的两条回答（「只有真分歧才送」「立,我来立」）。此前有六个已有先例的名字在等你批，PR 因此停在队外。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `.claude/` 规则文本，不动代码、门禁、AGENTS.md 和已裁的六张卡。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉的新增行和第 192 行的指针，然后看 `references/triage-duties.md` 第 40 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`，两门都绿，SKILL.md 仍是 319 行。
- 需要你做的：无。契约复审 PASS（6597105684，增量 6597189423）在案，Tier S，由席位落地。

席位意见：两句话正好是你的原话转成规则，人工地板和条款②都没碰，同意落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#3 · head `f93dee0dc5764b56684886cde44ff9acfa42a580`

- **Shape:** `Fixes #29663`; draft, base `main`, relay-opened (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`), label `skip-changeset`, no assignees. Diff `origin/main...f93dee0d`: 2 files, +3 −2, both under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`.
- **Premise measured:** at dispatch, neither file carried a precedent rule, and the `needs-user-decision` definition sat on `triage-duties.md` line 39 (the card said 42). The dev confirmed both; the new line sits directly under it.
- **Gates (check-runs at this head):** no red. Seven lint and type jobs were still running at ACCEPT, and all seven read `success` on the previous head `87c5223b`, which differs by two in-place line rewrites. The seat readies only after every check on this head is `success` or an expected skip.
- **Contract review:** record 6597105684 on `87c5223b` (PASS, two should-fix); both should-fixes were sent back as a seat-paid patch round and closed by `f93dee0d`. Delta record 6597189423 on this head: PASS, zero must-fix, nothing new.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; no package moves, so `skip-changeset` (precedent PR #29717); `Check Changeset` green on `87c5223b`.
- **Accepted deviations:** the sentence landed in both files, which the card's Reader line allows ("and/or"). The ratchet is paid by moving the six-line roster to a pointer at `os-dev.md` (lines 288-290 there carry it verbatim). `Skills-docs:` not owed (kind `none`).
- **Out of scope:** none.
- **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 29825`: Tier S (`.claude/**` ×2), 5 changed lines. Ready + auto-merge once every check on `f93dee0d` concludes.
